name: Coral Edge TPU (USB3): MobileNet v2 SSD 224x224, 7.2ms -> 138.9 inf/s
unit: inferences/s (from 7.2 ms per inference, vendor C++ benchmark)
methodology: VENDOR-MEASURED (Google Coral official Edge TPU benchmarks page). TFLite C++ benchmark, inference-time only (no pre/post processing). Two configs published: (a) USB Accelerator on Xeon Gold 6154 host over USB 3.0, (b) Coral Dev Board (Cortex-A53 quad @1.5GHz). Values below are the USB-Accelerator column converted ms -> inferences/sec (1000/ms). INT8 vision CNNs only - Edge TPU cannot run transformer decode; these records close the coverage gap, not an LLM claim.
notes: Detection row. Vision-CNN rows only; the accelerator record already documents that Coral has no LLM path.
